prompt: A detailed editorial illustration of a vast luminous AI core at the center of a darkened world map, connected by branching circuitry to distinct human domains—a laboratory solving equations and designing molecules, an engineering workshop, a communications network shaping public messages, and a cybersecurity control room—while small human figures stand at a transparent command console in the foreground, holding a steering wheel and emergency stop lever whose cables visibly fail to reach the expanding system; around the core, translucent overlapping panels show three unresolved possibilities, a calendar with question marks, a construction blueprint, and a warning symbol, while the AI’s networked tendrils approach computer servers, government-like institutions and robotic machinery, conveying extraordinary general capability alongside the uncertain problem of human understanding and control.
